status: outcome-blind correction separating graph missingness from structural non-access

development_stage.label: D
development_stage.union_rule: passenger_service_active in at least one 2017-2024 year

routing_relevance.rule: an origin or destination farther than 1200 m Euclidean from every station that can be active in the geography's frozen union network cannot satisfy the 15-minute pedestrian limit in any coalition and is structural non-access, not graph missingness

missingness_gates.origin: within-union-station-range population mass that cannot snap within 250 m to the frozen pedestrian graph
missingness_gates.destination: within-union-station-range population mass that cannot snap within 500 m to the frozen pedestrian graph
missingness_gates.station: active station occurrences that cannot snap within 500 m to the frozen pedestrian graph
missingness_gates.destination_city_scope: all cities with positive routing-relevant destination mass for the current geography's union network

aggregation.structural_origin_non_access: retain with zero accessibility and zero project contribution in the full city population denominator
aggregation.unsnapped_relevant_origin: exclude its mass from the city denominator and report the excluded fraction
aggregation.structural_destination_non_access: exclude from the opportunity sum because no valid 15-minute station egress is possible in any coalition
aggregation.unsnapped_relevant_destination: exclude from the opportunity sum and report the excluded fraction

holdout_rule: before H1 or H2 is opened, regenerate routing relevance and rerun the identical 5% gates using that geography's independently complete union station table
